MAP is like local health coverage for people without insurance. You must apply and show proof of income, address, and ID. Once approved, you can use MAP at places like CommUnityCare. Call or visit to start your MAP application.
resources.address: 1111 E Cesar Chavez St, Austin, TX 78702
resources.availability_status: Open for new applications - wait times for visits may be long

resources.name: Texas Health and Human Services – Benefits Office (Medicaid and CHIP)
resources.description: Get help applying for Medicaid (free health care for low income) and CHIP (kids' health insurance). These programs can help pay for some dental care, mainly for children and young adults. You must meet income and age rules. You can apply online, by phone, or at the office. Bring ID, proof of income, and proof of address if you go in person.
resources.availability_status: Open for new applications; most help is by phone or online

resources.name: Adult Protective Services – Texas Department of Family and Protective Services
resources.description: Get help if someone is hurting you, taking your money, or not caring for you. This help is for people age 65 or older, or adults with disabilities. You can report abuse, neglect, or money harm. Staff can visit you, talk with you, and help you make a safety plan. They can work with police and other groups if needed. You can call any time, day or night. You can report even if you are not sure. They can also help you find other local help.
resources.availability_status: 24/7 hotline – call any time

resources.name: Texas Legal Services Center – Elder Law and Financial Safety
resources.description: Get free legal help if you are an older adult hurt by money scams or family money harm. Help is for people age 60 or older, or people with low income. Lawyers can help stop abuse, protect your money, and talk with banks or family. They can help with power of attorney, wills, and other papers. They can also help you talk to Adult Protective Services or police. Most help is by phone, so you do not have to travel. Call to see if you can get help.
resources.address: 1920 East Riverside Drive, Suite A-120, Austin, TX 78741
resources.availability_status: Call for current intake hours

resources.name: Texas RioGrande Legal Aid – Austin
resources.description: Get free legal help if you have low income and someone has taken your money or property. They can help with money harm by family, scams, or debt problems. They can also help with housing, safety, and other civil legal problems. You must meet income rules to get help. They may talk with you by phone first. If they cannot take your case, they may help you find another place. Call to apply or to ask questions.
resources.availability_status: May have waitlist – call to apply

resources.name: AGE of Central Texas – Caregiver and Older Adult Support
resources.description: Get help for older adults and their families, like classes, support groups, and advice. They can help you understand money harm, plan for safety, and find trusted helpers. They offer a free help line to answer questions about aging, memory loss, and care. They can guide you to legal help, Adult Protective Services, and other local places. Some programs are free; some may have small fees. Call to learn what help you can get.
resources.availability_status: Open weekdays – call for hours and program openings

resources.name: Family Eldercare – Money Management and Senior Support
resources.description: Get help if you are an older adult and need safe help with money and bills. They can help protect you from money harm and scams. Staff or trained helpers can help pay bills, make a budget, and watch for abuse. They also offer support for people who live alone, like phone check-ins and help finding care. Some programs are for people with low income. Call to see which programs fit you and if there is a waitlist.
resources.availability_status: Some programs may have waitlist – call first

resources.description: Get free help for people age 60 or older, like legal aid, benefits help, and safety planning. resources.address: 6800 Burleson Road, Building 310, Suite 165, Austin, TX 78744
resources.availability_status: Open weekdays – call for an appointment

resources.name: Austin Police Department – Elder Abuse and Financial Crimes (Non-Emergency)
